D: Carter and Lee chase a counterfeiting ring from Hong Kong to Las Vegas.
P: Serve the mains when they hit the Red Dragon casino.
S: Shortcrust or puff pastry cases filled with egg custard (eggs, milk, sugar syrup, evaporated milk), baked at 200C for 15 minutes until just set.
Pork mince, chopped prawn, shiitake, ginger and soy in open wonton wrappers, steamed 8 minutes, carrot on top.
Salt and pepper prawns: shell-on prawns dusted in potato starch, fried at 190C, tossed with fried garlic, chilli and spring onion.
M: Roast duck (goose is hard to find): five spice and salt inside, skin dried overnight, glazed with maltose or honey, roasted at 180C for 90 minutes. Plum sauce, rice.
Carved roast beef with gravy, crab legs, mac and cheese and a bread roll, all on one plate.
W: Cook sago pearls until clear, rinse, chill. Blend mango with coconut milk and evaporated milk, fold in sago, top with diced mango and pomelo.
K: strong and sweet, pulled through a cloth
Brew strong black tea for 5 minutes, strain through a fine cloth twice, add evaporated milk and sugar. Hot or over ice.

s.how: Dissolve 70g caster sugar in 120ml hot water and cool. Whisk in 3 eggs, 80ml evaporated milk and 40ml full cream milk, then strain. Cut 12 rounds from 2 sheets puff pastry and press into a greased patty tin. Fill three quarters full and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until the custard is just set with a slight wobble.

Dry 500g shell-on green prawns well, season with salt and white pepper and toss in 60g potato starch. Fry in batches at 190C for 2 minutes until crisp. In a wok, fry 4 sliced garlic cloves, 1 sliced red chilli and 2 sliced spring onions in a little oil for 30 seconds, add the prawns and toss well.

m.how: Rub the cavity of a 2kg whole duck with 2 tsp five spice and 1 tsp salt, and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry the skin. Brush with 2 tbsp honey loosened with hot water and roast at 180C for 90 minutes, brushing again twice. Rest 15 minutes and chop through the bone. Serve with 150ml plum sauce and 2 cups jasmine rice.

w.how: Boil 80g sago pearls in plenty of water for 15 minutes until clear, then rinse under cold water and chill. Blend the flesh of 2 mangoes with 200ml coconut milk and 100ml evaporated milk. Fold in the sago, divide into bowls and top with diced mango from a third mango and segments of half a pomelo.

d.note: strong and sweet, pulled through a cloth
d.how: Simmer 4 tbsp loose black tea in 800ml water for 5 minutes. Strain twice through a fine cloth or sieve for a smooth tea. Add 200ml evaporated milk and 4 tsp caster sugar, stir, and serve hot or poured over ice.
